title: Quarter the optimizer batch (2^19 -> 2^17)
description: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE 2**19 -> 2**17 and DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE 128 -> 64 (grad_accum=1), all LRs and architecture unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 0.997445 vs baseline 0.997359 - a dead heat (+0.00009), not an improvement. 3176 steps and 416M tokens vs the baseline's ~800 steps/~480M: 4x the optimizer updates on 13% fewer tokens bought exactly nothing. MFU fell 40% -> 33.4% because DEVICE_BATCH_SIZE dropped to 64, so part of the token loss is my device-batch confound, but the headline is that val_bpb is essentially flat across a 4x batch range. That strongly suggests this setup is already at or past the flat region of the batch/step tradeoff and that batch size is not where the remaining loss is - the group should stop spending runs on batch sweeps (including further 2^16 probes) and move to architecture/schedule/LR. Peak VRAM 22.7GB at device batch 64, so there is room to grow the model.
